items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: He used to, you take and cut the number off the top of the music and give it to you, it'd be a number, like sudden such a number. Sands.

ctx.x: Well how does and what they played compared with the New Orleans brass bands of today?

Well, I'll tell you, the numbers they played the day most every brass band hit the street, you know, except the Eureka, the Young Tuxedo, bands like that. Well I would say the Dejan's Olympia brass band might bring some music out, you know. The Eureka always brings the music out, and a long time ago, the bands, very few brass bands didn't use music, most all of them had music. But they used to cut the name off the music, so when they hired a fellow to play at the band, he don't know what number he's playing, make…
Same way to do the day.
